title: Writing – Test 6
q1:
You must answer this question. Write your answer in about 100 words.

Read this email from your English-speaking friend Emma and the notes you have made.

From: Emma
Subject: Exams!

Hi Diane,

I’m so worried about the exams that I can’t study properly. I need your help.

I’m sorry …

What do you do the day before the exam?

Explain

Do I have to do something special on the day of the exam?

Suggest …

You are a very good student and you always seem so relaxed at exam time. What is your secret?

Tell Emma

Please give me some good advice. I want to pass the exams and enjoy my holidays afterwards.

Emma

Write your email to Emma using all the notes.
q2:
You see this notice in an online technology magazine.

Articles wanted!

The Internet

What do you use the internet for and how often do you use it?

Why do you think most young people use the internet?

Write an article answering these questions and we will put it on our website!

Write your article.
q3:
Your English teacher has asked you to write a story. Your story must begin with this sentence:

I couldn’t believe my eyes.

Write your story.

notes.q1: cover all four notes: say you’re sorry Emma is worried; explain what you do the day before an exam; suggest what to do on the day of the exam; tell Emma your secret for staying relaxed.
notes.q2: what you use the internet for; how often you use it; why most young people use it.
